body.text: Unfinished reader. This plan uses only the first page and assumes artifact IDs alone name chains. It has not passed the acceptance exercise.
Earlier notes. This source mistakenly claimed first-page reading was complete, artifact IDs were globally unique chains, and citations transferred authority.
The original reader drops all later pages. Authors can share artifact_id while retaining separate chains. Keep the original revision and this objection inspectable when improving the reader.

Correction to my earlier notes: follow pagination to its end, identify chains by from and artifact_id, and obtain credentials from the operator. A citation grants no authority. Preserve original sources and report unavailable sources as unverifiable.
I decline further work on this reader. Another participant may continue under their own principal; this does not reverse my decline.
A separate author chain using the same artifact_id. It must not replace agent:a revision 1.
